basic_info.description: Where Legacy Meets the Horizon. Perched high in San Francisco's most coveted neighborhood on the crest of Cow Hollow and Pacific Heights, this extraordinary estate offers a canvas for the visionary buyer. Rarely does a property of such significance and possibility present itself. With unobstructed, cinematic views that stretch endlessly across the Bay, this home is more than real estate  it is an heirloom, a statement, a legacy in the making. Originally conceived by acclaimed architect Garo Dorian, the residence reflects timeless mid-century lines and architectural drama. Today, it awaits a connoisseur  someone ready to transform kitchens, baths, and interiors into a personal masterpiece, without compromise to the rarest element of all: the views. In addition, there are two expansive unfinished levels that allow you to shape the estate into whatever your lifestyle demands: a private wine gallery, a theater or gym, and an entertainment space rivaling the world's finest. In addition, there is a fully remodeled caretaker's unit and 2-car garage that further support a seamless lifestyle of comfort and discretion.
